findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pricing_and_packages, calculate_event_cost, recommend_scavenger_quests, get_platform_stats · Private data: get_pricing_and_packages, calculate_event_cost, recommend_scavenger_quests, create_event_checkout, get_platform_stats · Public sink: get_pricing_and_packages · Destructive: get_pricing_and_packages, calculate_event_cost, recommend_scavenger_quests, create_event_checkout, get_platform_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pricing_and_packages, calculate_event_cost, recommend_scavenger_quests, get_platform_stats · Private data: get_pricing_and_packages, calculate_event_cost, recommend_scavenger_quests, create_event_checkout, get_platform_stats · Public sink: get_pricing_and_packages · Destructive: get_pricing_and_packages, calculate_event_cost, recommend_scavenger_quests, create_event_checkout, get_platform_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
